title: Is Skiing Gay? | Chad Goes Deep | Stand Up Comedy
description:
Chad on being a philosophy major, why he doesn't snowboard, and how he met his fianceé at a rave

Comedy is at its best when there's a surprise – that's why Don't Tell Comedy puts on events where the performers and location are kept secret until the day of the show. With over 200 cities already in on the joke, you never know where we'll set up shop, or who might pop in. Want to be let in on the secret? Visit our website below to find an upcoming show near you: https://www.donttellcomedy.com

Just don't tell anyone!! 🤫

-----------------------------------------------------------

Chad (@chadgoesdeep) is a Southern California comedian known for his activist city council pranks, movie quotes in public, and delivering Stoke Seminars on the art of choosing stoke. Catch his one-man show, Chill Towards Enlightenment, coming to a town near you. Tickets at chadandjt.com.
